title: opum-lore pane: no auto-start in teammate, headless or workflow processes; once-registered, in-flight-guarded clocks
description:
Filed by lore-cli's session from opum-doc DEC-172 (4bg), the design ruling relayed via team-lead on 2026-10-12; item 2 of that ruling's per-repository spec is the binding scope for lore-cli.

Context: a host load incident on 2026-10-12 (DEC-172 (4bg) records host load 128/225/269 at 03:07:43Z). Mod clocks ran in every Claude process - teammates, headless and workflow processes alike. The opum-lore pane auto-opens on session.start and refreshes every 30s, and its refresh has NO in-flight guard (lore findings B1 and B2); there is no session.end handler, so no timer is ever cancelled (B3). There is NO fleet mode in opum-lore to remove: the "Refs" view reads refs in its own repository, so only the auto-start gate and the clock hardening apply.

Operator's first-party ruling, recorded verbatim in DEC-172 (4bg): "teammates, and dynamic workflows should not be running the mode automatically".

Scope (DEC-172 (4bg) item 2, HIGH): implement lore-cli's items (b), (c) and (e) as written, plus an in-flight guard on refresh. Item (a) - removing fleet mode - does not apply, because opum-lore has none. Not campaign work.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Auto-start gate: on session.start, when !e.isInteractive OR $.env.get("CLAUDECODE") === "1", open no pane and register no clock. An explicit open by the person still works and polls only while shown.

Every clock is registered once per process (a module guard), its handle is kept, and it is cancelled at session.end. Each WHOLE clock callback is guarded in flight, skipping a tick while the previous one runs. The refresh gets its own in-flight guard as well.
Every subprocess has a timeout, and no tick spawns more than 3 processes.

Proof both ways: a CLAUDECODE=1 process, and one with isInteractive false, each spawn 0 lore/git children over 5 minutes; an interactive process stays within the bound; a soak of 8 interactive processes for 10 minutes shows no growth in child processes, with the counts reported; and claude plugin validate lists the env read.
